description: This PHP source file appears to set up SOAP web service methods for managing custom fields within SuiteCRM. It defines metadata for different custom field types, registers the 'set_custom_field' SOAP method, and implements logic to create or update custom fields in modules, including validation, layout modifications, and interaction with ModuleBuilder components.

classes.name: SoapError
classes.description: A class used for handling SOAP errors and generating error arrays.

methods.name: set_custom_field
methods.description: Creates or updates a custom field for a specified module, validating permissions, preparing data, invoking ModuleBuilder controllers to generate the field, and optionally updating module layouts.
